elements.label: Table 4.9
elements.title: Three Possible Setups for the Null and Alternative Hypotheses for a Population Mean (Two Samples)
elements.details:
| Setup A | Setup B | Setup C |
|---------|---------|---------|
| H₀ : μ₁ = μ₂ | H₀ : μ₁ ≤ μ₂ | H₀ : μ₁ ≥ μ₂ |
| Hₐ : μ₁ ≠ μ₂ | Hₐ : μ₁ > μ₂ | Hₐ : μ₁ < μ₂ |
elements.summary: This table shows three possible setups for null and alternative hypotheses when comparing population means from two samples.
